title: Outgrow
statement: Growth sometimes requires stepping beyond the boundaries that have become too confining.

versions.title: Codex
versions.author: codex
versions.summary: First interpretation: concentric shell, repeated strikes, figure eight and rosette, winged form.

versions.title: Claude — wings
versions.author: claude
versions.summary: Faster rework: one continuous set of 24 lines morphs from rings to wings; reactive camera.

versions.title: Claude — text ending
versions.author: claude
versions.summary: The soul flies an S-curve out of the wings; a spark writes Break / the shape. / Keep / becoming.
